text:
Maya (CEO): leaving the post-all-hands Q&A for the wins/losses segment  paste any follow-ups or asks here so we can capture owners
Liam (Head of Sales): quick field summary: closed a mid-market deal after offering a scoped eval + short integration assist; lost an early-stage buyer who chose a cheaper quantized self-host option
Elena (Customer Success): confirmed. the assisted eval (sanitization + scoring + short runbook) was repeatedly called out as the deciding factor by several customers
Sam P. (VP Product): for the losses: was it purely price or also perceived ops burden?
Liam (Head of Sales): mostly price and perceived ongoing ops. procurement flagged ongoing spend vs a one-time infra lift
Rohit (Solutions Eng): demo win checklist: pre-warm KV caches, pin a small Dedicated pool during the pilot, and show a simple rollback plan. that combo reduced tail spikes in two cases
Anya (PM): Product proposals: 1) publish a short public "latency profile" explainer; 2) create a Starter Dedicated quickstart for small teams; 3) formalize a scoped, billable "eval assistance" add-on with clear caps
LegalBot: recommend add-on template with capped hours (e.g., 12 eng hours), defined deliverable (evaluation report), and exclusions. Legal will draft standard wording once pricing is proposed
Rohit (Solutions Eng): also add a troubleshooting appendix for common causes of regressions: tokenization changes, prompt truncation, quantization mismatch, model-variant swaps. include tiny code snippets for quick checks
Elena (Customer Success): CS asks: include an "eval checklist" Sales can use in calls (data prep, PII redaction steps, sample prompts, success criteria). that materially shortens eval time
Liam (Head of Sales): Sales wants a 1-slide cheat sheet: why customers pick us, what to offer as add-ons, 3 demo config snippets (latency-first, balanced, cost-first)
Sam P. (VP Product): agreed. also bump one sprint for pre-warm/pinning UX and add a small Console card for "output stability" (prompt-drift, token-length histogram, recent regressions)
Anya (PM): action items I’ll own: draft latency explainer (public), Starter Dedicated quickstart (sales-facing), Sales slide, and an eval checklist. draft by Tue EOD, final Wed AM
DeployBot: docs/plays/starter-dedicated-quickstart.md created by Anya at 2245678955 :white_check_mark:
Maya (CEO): can Legal draft the add-on template parallel to Product drafts? Sales pilots pricing with two customers will help finalize numbers
LegalBot: yes  will draft a short addendum for the eval offering with clear caps. ping when you have proposed pricing
Liam (Head of Sales): I'll DM anonymized RFP snippets and price sensitivity notes to Anya and Sam this afternoon
Maya (CEO): excellent. please keep updates in this thread and tag Anya for follow-ups. we’ll review progress in next leadership sync :sparkles:
